query: UPDATE job_item ji SET state = 'queued', blocked_on = NULL, park_expires_at = NULL, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 FROM job j WHERE j.org_id = ji.org_id AND j.id = ji.job_id AND ji.state = 'parked_live' AND ji.blocked_on = $1 AND ji.operation <> 'create' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connection c WHERE c.org_id = ji.org_id AND c.marketplace = j.marketplace AND c.state = 'linked') RETURNING ji.org_id, ji.job_id, ji.id
